name: bionic-code-reader
description: Apply configurable Bionic-style emphasis directly to source code in the VS Code editor.

commands.title: Bionic Code Reader: Increase Fixation Strength
Bionic Code Reader: Decrease Fixation Strength

bionicCodeReader.enabled.description: Apply Bionic-style emphasis in supported text editors.

bionicCodeReader.fixationStrength.description: Fraction of each word emphasized, rounded up. Higher values emphasize more characters.

bionicCodeReader.saccades.description: Number of words skipped after each emphasized word. 0 emphasizes every word; 1 skips every second word.

bionicCodeReader.fontWeight.description: Font weight used for emphasized characters.

bionicCodeReader.excludedLanguages.description: Language IDs that should not receive Bionic formatting.

bionicCodeReader.updateDelay.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds after editing.
